docFindings.doc: 291｜WeCom 与 Wechat Channel 单文件详解.md
evidence: Doc lines 28-39 describe frontend route/core/component layering, but this chapter is about backend IM channels.

Source: backend/app/channels/service.py registers wechat/wecom channel classes and starts enabled channels; backend/app/channels/wecom.py starts a WSClient, registers message handlers, subscribes outbound, and sends outbound attachments only on final messages; backend/app/channels/manager.py registers inbound file readers for wecom/wechat.
docFindings.issue: Wrong supplemental design section: it attributes WeCom/Wechat channel design to frontend route/core/component layering, which is unrelated and misleading.
docFindings.patch:
```diff
--- a/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/291｜WeCom 与 Wechat Channel 单文件详解.md
+++ b/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/291｜WeCom 与 Wechat Channel 单文件详解.md
@@
 <callout emoji="💡">
-**设计目的：**前端按 route、core 数据层、业务组件、UI primitive 分层，是为了降低组件耦合。
+**设计目的：**WeCom/Wechat channel 把不同 IM 协议收敛成统一的 `MessageBus` 入站/出站消息，再交给 `ChannelManager` 调用 DeerFlow 运行时。
 </callout>
 
 | 维度 | 说明 |
 |-|-|
-| 收益 | 收益是展示层和数据请求分离，组件更容易复用。 |
-| 代价 | 代价是一次用户交互常跨页面、hook、缓存、上下文和组件。 |
-| 重点代码 | 重点代码在 `frontend/src/app`、`frontend/src/core`、`frontend/src/components` 对应模块。 |
-| 阅读路径 | 阅读路径：先找 route，再找 hook 数据源，最后看组件消费。 |
+| 收益 | 收益是 WeCom WebSocket、Wechat iLink long-poll、附件读取和出站回复都能复用同一套 channel manager 分派逻辑。 |
+| 代价 | 代价是 WeCom 依赖 SDK 的 WebSocket/media upload 能力，Wechat 依赖 iLink cursor、AES/CDN 和本地下载目录，附件处理需要按 channel 分支读取。 |
+| 重点代码 | 重点代码在 `backend/app/channels/wecom.py`、`backend/app/channels/wechat.py`、`backend/app/channels/manager.py`、`backend/app/channels/service.py`。 |
+| 阅读路径 | 阅读路径：先看 `ChannelService` 如何加载 channel，再看 channel 入站回调如何 publish inbound，最后看 `ChannelManager` 如何读取附件并把结果发回 outbound。 |
 
 ```mermaid
-flowchart TD
-  A[设计目的] --> B[解决的问题]
-  B --> C[收益]
-  B --> D[代价]
-  C --> E[重点代码]
-  D --> E
-  E --> F[阅读路径]
+flowchart TD
+  Service[ChannelService] --> WeCom[WeComChannel]
+  Service --> Wechat[WechatChannel]
+  WeCom --> Bus[MessageBus inbound/outbound]
+  Wechat --> Bus
+  Bus --> Manager[ChannelManager]
+  Manager --> Runtime[LangGraph/Gateway run]
+  Runtime --> Outbound[OutboundMessage]
+  Outbound --> WeCom
+  Outbound --> Wechat
 ```
```

evidence: Doc lines 30-39 describe API/router/service/repository boundaries, but source settings files are browser-local settings and per-thread model overrides.

Source: frontend/src/core/settings/local.ts defines `deerflow.local-settings` and `deerflow.thread-model.` localStorage keys, default notification/tokenUsage/context settings, and `applyThreadModelOverride`; frontend/src/core/settings/store.ts uses `useSyncExternalStore` backing store, storage event listener, base settings, and per-thread model map; frontend/src/core/settings/hooks.ts exposes `useLocalSettings` and `useThreadSettings`.
docFindings.issue: Wrong supplemental design section: settings are not an API/backend boundary module; the actual design is a localStorage-backed external store with cross-tab storage sync and per-thread model override.
docFindings.patch:
```diff
--- a/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/297｜Frontend Core Settings 文件详解.md
+++ b/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/297｜Frontend Core Settings 文件详解.md
@@
 <callout emoji="💡">

 </callout>
 
 | 维度 | 说明 |
 |-|-|
-| 收益 | 收益是前后端契约清晰，接口可独立演进。 |

-| 阅读路径 | 阅读路径：从 URL/API 入口往内追 service，再看数据落到哪里。 |
+| 收益 | 收益是 UI 读写设置不需要 React Query 或后端请求，并且同一浏览器多标签页可通过 storage event 同步。 |

+| 重点代码 | 重点代码在 `frontend/src/core/settings/local.ts`、`frontend/src/core/settings/store.ts`、`frontend/src/core/settings/hooks.ts`。 |

docFindings.doc: 301｜Chat Hooks 与 ChatBox 单文件详解.md
evidence: Doc lines 14-23 only show URL/useThreadChat/useChatMode/ChatBox, but source contains critical runtime state transitions.

Source: ChatPage keeps `isNewThread` separate from visual `isWelcomeMode`, flips welcome mode on `onSend`, uses native `history.replaceState` on `onStart`, and gates token usage/history for new/mock threads. `useThreadStream` tracks optimisticMessages, optimisticThreadId, liveMessagesThreadId, isUploading, onStreamThreadId, sendInFlightRef, pendingUsageBaselineMessageIdsRef, and clears/invalidates on error/finish.
docFindings.issue: Missing state transition diagram for the chat runtime. This is learner-facing risk because `/new` route, visual welcome mode, backend thread creation, upload/optimistic state, and stream finish/error cleanup are the hard parts of the chat flow.
docFindings.patch:
```diff
--- a/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/301｜Chat Hooks 与 ChatBox 单文件详解.md
+++ b/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/301｜Chat Hooks 与 ChatBox 单文件详解.md
@@
 ```mermaid
 flowchart TD
   URL --> UseThreadChat
   UseThreadChat --> ThreadId
@@
   Index --> Exports
 ```
+
+## 运行时状态机补充
+
+`useThreadChat` 只负责从路由得到当前展示 thread id：`/new` 会先生成临时 uuid。真正提交时，`ChatPage` 的 `isNewThread` 仍保持为 true，避免 SDK 过早请求尚未存在的后端 history；`isWelcomeMode` 则会在 `onSend` 立即变为 false，用于先切换视觉布局。后端创建 thread 后，`onStart` 使用 `history.replaceState` 原地替换 URL，再写入真实 thread id 并关闭 new-thread 状态。
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+  [*] --> NewRoute: /workspace/chats/new
+  NewRoute --> TempThreadId: useThreadChat creates uuid
+  TempThreadId --> WelcomeMode: isNewThread=true / isWelcomeMode=true
+  WelcomeMode --> SubmittedVisual: onSend sets isWelcomeMode=false
+  SubmittedVisual --> Uploading: message.files.length > 0
+  Uploading --> SubmittedToStream: uploadFiles success
+  SubmittedVisual --> SubmittedToStream: no files
+  SubmittedToStream --> BackendCreated: useStream onCreated/onStart
+  BackendCreated --> StableThread: history.replaceState + setThreadId + setIsNewThread(false)
+  StableThread --> Streaming: thread.submit streamSubgraphs/resumable
+  Streaming --> Finished: onFinish invalidates thread caches and token usage
+  Streaming --> Error: onError clears optimistic/live state and toasts
+```
+
+| 状态点 | 来源 |
+|-|-|
+| 临时 thread id | `use-thread-chat.ts` 的 `newThreadIdRef`。 |
+| 视觉欢迎态 | `ChatPage` 的 `isWelcomeMode`，不同于 `isNewThread`。 |
+| 乐观消息 | `useThreadStream` 的 `optimisticMessages` / `optimisticThreadId` / `liveMessagesThreadId`。 |
+| 上传中 | `isUploading` 和临时 AI task message。 |
+| 后端创建 | `useStream.onCreated` / `onStart`。 |
+| 结束/失败 | `onFinish`、`onError` 清理状态并刷新 threads/token usage query。 |
 
 ---
```

docFindings.doc: 302｜Artifact File List _ Detail _ Trigger 单文件详解.md
evidence: Doc lines 14-23 collapse artifact behavior into PreviewOrDownload, but source has multiple runtime branches.

Source: ArtifactsProvider owns artifacts, selectedArtifact, autoSelect, open, autoOpen and closes the main sidebar on selection; ChatBox synchronizes `thread.values.artifacts`, deselects on thread changes, and resizes panels between 100/0 and 60/40; ArtifactFileDetail treats `write-file:` artifacts specially, previews markdown with Streamdown, previews HTML through a Blob URL iframe, injects base href and scroll-restoration script, and uses `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms"`.
docFindings.issue: Missing runtime/interactive preview diagram. The source has a strong interactive visualization surface (HTML artifact preview iframe with scripts/forms and scroll restoration), but the doc only says preview/download.
docFindings.patch:
```diff
--- a/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/302｜Artifact File List _ Detail _ Trigger 单文件详解.md
+++ b/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/302｜Artifact File List _ Detail _ Trigger 单文件详解.md
@@
 ```mermaid
 flowchart TD
   ThreadArtifacts --> Provider
@@
   List --> InstallSkill
 ```
+
+## Artifact 面板与预览状态补充
+
+Artifact 面板不是单纯的文件列表。`ArtifactsProvider` 保存 `artifacts`、`selectedArtifact`、`open`、`autoOpen`、`autoSelect`；`ChatBox` 每次从 `thread.values.artifacts` 同步列表，thread 切换时会 `deselect()`，并根据打开状态把左右 panel 从 100/0 调整为 60/40。
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart TD
+  ThreadState[thread.values.artifacts] --> ChatBox
+  ChatBox --> ProviderSetArtifacts[ArtifactsProvider.setArtifacts]
+  Trigger[ArtifactTrigger] --> OpenPanel[setOpen true]
+  ListClick[ArtifactFileList click] --> SelectArtifact[select artifact]
+  SelectArtifact --> CloseSidebar[close workspace sidebar]
+  SelectArtifact --> Detail[ArtifactFileDetail]
+  Detail --> WriteFile{write-file: URL?}
+  WriteFile -->|yes| ToolCallDraft[build draft from tool call]
+  WriteFile -->|no| FetchArtifact[fetch /api/threads/:id/artifacts]
+  Detail --> ViewMode{language}
+  ViewMode -->|markdown| StreamdownPreview
+  ViewMode -->|html| HtmlBlobIframe[Blob iframe + base href + scroll restoration]
+  ViewMode -->|other code| CodeEditorReadonly
+  ViewMode -->|non-code| RawArtifactIframe
+```
+
+| 分支 | 说明 |
+|-|-|
+| `write-file:` | 从 tool call 参数和 tool result 组合草稿内容；失败 tool result 不展示 preview。 |
+| markdown | 使用 `ClipboardSafeStreamdown`，链接走 `ArtifactLink`。 |
+| html | 生成 Blob URL iframe，注入 `<base>` 与滚动恢复脚本，sandbox 允许 scripts/forms。 |
+| `.skill` | 列表和详情都可触发 `installSkill`，静态 demo 下禁用详情安装。 |
 
 ---
```

evidence: Doc lines 15-23 only show generic MessageList -> getMessageGroups -> MessageListItem/MessageGroup and history loading.

Source: MessageList has explicit branches for `human`/`assistant`, `assistant:clarification`, `assistant:present-files`, `assistant:subagent`, and fallback tool/reasoning groups; it also renders token usage per turn/debug, assistant copy button, subtask cards, and a throttled IntersectionObserver history loader.
docFindings.issue: Missing runtime routing diagram for message group types. The current doc hides the key rendering state machine that determines whether a stream update becomes normal markdown, clarification, artifact cards, subtask cards, tool/reasoning chain, token usage, or history loader.
docFindings.patch:
```diff
--- a/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/303｜MessageList 组件族细节详解.md
+++ b/.agent_context/final_review/docs_md/303｜MessageList 组件族细节详解.md
@@
 ```mermaid
 flowchart TD
   ThreadContext --> MessageList
@@
   ThreadContext --> ChildComponents
 ```
+
+## MessageList 分组渲染状态补充
+
+`MessageList` 的核心不是只把消息逐条渲染出来，而是先用 `getMessageGroups` 把消息分成不同 UI 分支，再分别接入 markdown、artifact、subtask、tool/reasoning、token usage 与历史加载。
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart TD
+  Messages[thread.messages] --> Groups[getMessageGroups]
+  Groups --> Normal{human or assistant}
+  Normal --> MessageListItem
+  Normal --> AssistantCopy[assistant turn copy button]
+  Groups --> Clarification[assistant:clarification]
+  Clarification --> MarkdownContent
+  Groups --> PresentFiles[assistant:present-files]
+  PresentFiles --> ArtifactFileList
+  Groups --> Subagent[assistant:subagent]
+  Subagent --> UpdateSubtask[updateSubtask]
+  Subagent --> SubtaskCard
+  Groups --> ToolReasoning[fallback tool/reasoning]
+  ToolReasoning --> MessageGroup
+  Groups --> TokenUsage[per-turn or step-debug token usage]
+  HistorySentinel[LoadMoreHistoryIndicator] --> useThreadHistory
+```
+
+| 分支 | 组件/行为 |
+|-|-|
+| normal human/assistant | `MessageListItem`，assistant turn 额外显示整轮 copy。 |
+| clarification | 只渲染可见 markdown 内容。 |
+| present-files | 从消息抽取文件列表并显示 `ArtifactFileList`。 |
+| subagent | 从 `task` tool call/result 更新 subtask store，并显示 `SubtaskCard`。 |
+| fallback | `MessageGroup` 展示 tool call、reasoning、搜索结果、token debug。 |
+| history | 顶部 sentinel/button 触发节流的 `loadMoreHistory`。 |
 
 ---
```
